s1.title: About PitchKH
s1.body: PitchKH is the booking service for our football, volleyball and tennis pitches in Phnom Penh. You can book on this website or in our Telegram bot. No account is needed.

s2.title: Booking requests
s2.body: When you send a booking, we hold that pitch and time for you and your request waits for our confirmation. It becomes a confirmed booking once we confirm it on Telegram or by phone. We may decline a request, for example if the details are incomplete or the pitch is closed.

s3.title: Prices and payment
s3.body: The price shown when you book is the price for the pitch and time you chose, in US dollars, with the riel amount for guidance. Evening hours from 17:00 cost more. You pay at the venue; nothing is charged online.

s4.title: Changes and cancellations
s4.body: To change or cancel, message us on Telegram with your booking code as early as you can, so the pitch can go to another team. If you do not arrive, we may give the pitch to other players after 15 minutes, and repeated no-shows may be refused future bookings.

s5.title: At the venue
s5.body: Please arrive on time, follow the staff's instructions and treat the pitch, other players and our staff with respect. Sport has risks; you play at your own responsibility and should look after your own belongings.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: When you book: your name, phone number, the number of players and any note you add. If you book in our Telegram bot, we also receive your Telegram name, username and account number from Telegram. We do not collect payment details.

s2.title: How we use it
s2.body: Only to manage your booking: to hold your pitch, confirm or change the booking, and contact you about it by phone or Telegram. We do not send advertising and we do not sell your information.

s3.title: Who can see it
s3.body: Only PitchKH staff who handle bookings. Other customers see that a pitch is taken, never who booked it.

s4.title: Where it is kept
s4.body: Bookings are stored in a secure database (Neon, in Singapore) and the site runs on Vercel. Both protect data in transit with encryption. We keep booking records for up to 12 months, then delete them.

s5.title: Your choices
s5.body: You can ask us to show, correct or delete your booking details at any time. Message us on Telegram and include your booking code if you have one.
